options.content:
## Bot Visibility

**Provides visibility into how bots are interacting with your websites.**

Understand high-level trends in bot traffic and which AI bots are requesting resources from your site.

NOTE: THIS DASHBOARD IS SET TO QUERY FOR MAX OF 30 DAYS.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    count() as "Total Requests",
    countIf(notEmpty(bot_type) = 1) AS "Total Bot Requests",
    countIf(notEmpty(bot_type) = 1 AND bot_category = 'Artificial Intelligence (AI) Bots') AS "AI Bot Requests",
    timestamp
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY
    timestamp
    
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_max_timerange_sec=2592000, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Traffic breakdown; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    bot_category,
    count()
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND notEmpty(bot_type) = 1
GROUP BY bot_category
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_max_timerange_sec=2592000, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; Bot traffic percentage per category; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    toStartOfDay(timestamp) as time,
    count() as "All Bot Requests",
    bot_category    
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND notEmpty(bot_type) = 1
GROUP BY 
    time, bot_category
ORDER BY 
    count() DESC
    
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_max_timerange_sec=2592000, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot traffic; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    toStartOfDay(timestamp) as time,
    count(),
    botnet_id
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND notEmpty(bot_type) = 1
    AND bot_category = 'Artificial Intelligence (AI) Bots'
GROUP BY 
    time, botnet_id
ORDER BY 
    time, count() DESC
    
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_max_timerange_sec=2592000, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI traffic by bot; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    botnet_id,
    path,
    count() as count
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND notEmpty(bot_type) = 1
    AND bot_category = 'Artificial Intelligence (AI) Bots'
GROUP BY 
    botnet_id, path
ORDER BY
    count DESC
    
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_max_timerange_sec=2592000, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Resource request by bot; du=${__user.login}'

Additional Bot Insights from Web Security Analytics

targets.rawSql:
WITH cte AS (
  SELECT  
    timestamp,
    ${attackTypes_var} AS attackTypes
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(configId IN (${WAFConfig:sqlstring}), ${WAFConfig})
    AND $__conditionalAll(policyId IN (${WAFPolicy:sqlstring}),${WAFPolicy})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${bot_category_var:sqlstring}), ${bot_category_array}), ${bot_category_var})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${Bot_Id_var:sqlstring}), ${Bot_Id_array}), ${Bot_Id_var})
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
)
SELECT  
  toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(timestamp), ${interval}) AS time,  
  attackTypes, 
  count(*) as "Request Count"
FROM cte
ARRAY JOIN attackTypes
GROUP BY attackTypes, time  
ORDER BY count(*) desc

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT  
    timestamp,
    bot_type,
    ${bot_category_array} AS bot_category_array
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(configId IN (${WAFConfig:sqlstring}), ${WAFConfig})
    AND $__conditionalAll(policyId IN (${WAFPolicy:sqlstring}),${WAFPolicy})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${bot_category_var:sqlstring}), ${bot_category_array}), ${bot_category_var})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${Bot_Id_var:sqlstring}), ${Bot_Id_array}), ${Bot_Id_var})
    --AND notEmpty(toString(botData_responseSegment))
    AND notEmpty(bot_type)
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
)
SELECT 
  bot_category, 
  bot_type,  
  toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(timestamp), ${interval}) AS time,  
  count(*) 
FROM cte
ARRAY JOIN bot_category_array AS bot_category
GROUP BY bot_category, bot_type, time ORDER by count() DESC

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT  
    timestamp,
    bot_type
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(configId IN (${WAFConfig:sqlstring}), ${WAFConfig})
    AND $__conditionalAll(policyId IN (${WAFPolicy:sqlstring}),${WAFPolicy})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${bot_category_var:sqlstring}), ${bot_category_array}), ${bot_category_var})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${Bot_Id_var:sqlstring}), ${Bot_Id_array}), ${Bot_Id_var})
    AND notEmpty(bot_type)
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
)
SELECT 
  bot_type, 
  toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(timestamp), ${interval}) as time, 
  count(*)  AS "Count Requests Bot Type" 
FROM cte 
GROUP BY bot_type, time

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT  
    timestamp,
    multiIf(botScore = 0, '0',
                botScore between 1 and 10, '1-10', 
                botScore between 11 and 20, '11-20', 
                botScore between 21 and 30, '21-30',
                botScore between 31 and 40, '31-40',
                botScore between 41 and 50, '41-50',
                botScore between 51 and 60, '51-60',
                botScore between 61 and 70, '61-70',
                botScore between 71 and 80, '71-80',
                botScore between 81 and 90, '81-90',
                botScore between 91 and 100, '91-100', '') AS botScoreRange  
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(configId IN (${WAFConfig:sqlstring}), ${WAFConfig})
    AND $__conditionalAll(policyId IN (${WAFPolicy:sqlstring}),${WAFPolicy})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${bot_category_var:sqlstring}), ${bot_category_array}), ${bot_category_var})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${Bot_Id_var:sqlstring}), ${Bot_Id_array}), ${Bot_Id_var})
    AND botScore IS NOT NULL
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
)
SELECT 
  botScoreRange,  
  toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(timestamp), ${interval}) as time,  
  count(*) 
FROM cte
GROUP BY botScoreRange, time

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT  
    timestamp,
    [rules] AS BotCategoryAkamai_array,
    ${bot_category_array} AS bot_category_array
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND $__conditionalAll(configId IN (${WAFConfig:sqlstring}), ${WAFConfig})
    AND $__conditionalAll(policyId IN (${WAFPolicy:sqlstring}),${WAFPolicy})
    --and notEmpty(bot_type)
    AND bot_type IN ('Akamai', 'Unknown')
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${bot_category_var:sqlstring}), ${bot_category_array}), ${bot_category_var})
    AND $__conditionalAll(arrayExists(x -> x IN (${Bot_Id_var:sqlstring}), ${Bot_Id_array}), ${Bot_Id_var})
    AND $__adHocFilter() 
)
SELECT 
  BotCategoryAkamai, 
  bot_category,  
  toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(timestamp), ${interval}) as time,  
  count(*) 
FROM cte
ARRAY JOIN BotCategoryAkamai_array AS BotCategoryAkamai, bot_category_array AS bot_category
GROUP BY BotCategoryAkamai, bot_category, time ORDER BY count() DESC
